record.question: Red light is used in traffic signals because
options: it is visible to people even with bad eyesight
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Provisional ( Preliminary ) - 2025 Answer Key Paper-I..pdf
record.explanation: Red has the longest wavelength within the visible spectrum. It is scattered less strongly than shorter-wavelength visible light by fine particles, helping a red signal remain visible at a distance. The wavelength comparison here concerns visible colours, not the whole electromagnetic spectrum.
